plotSections.title: Wall of Eyes
bullets: A wall of eyes fills the party's view at a door. Dana has moved as far away as possible and is not fully exposed; Carlkin is running away.
The three people still adjacent to the wall must make Wisdom saving throws. The effect is a magical mental ability, not sleep or charm.
Sylan saves with a 25 after using Indomitable. Gerk saves with a 23. Ord fails with a 17 and is overcome by the effect.

plotSections.title: Vigilant Rebuke
bullets: Ord, an Oath of the Watchers paladin (previously Oath of Vengeance), uses Vigilant Rebuke when allies succeed on the Wisdom save. It is a reaction, so it triggers only once.
The rebuke deals 14 damage. Several eyes on the very edge of the door pop.

plotSections.title: Ord Passes Through
bullets: Sylan and Gerk watch Ord step forward, find a gap between the eyes with his hand, and begin to pass into the wall.
Ord's mind is elsewhere. The scene with him is taken off the recorded channel, so what he experiences is not in this chunk.

chronologicalEvents: A wall of eyes presents itself. Dana is far enough away not to be fully exposed, and Carlkin runs.
Wisdom saves are called for the three people still adjacent. The effect is a magical mental ability, not charm or sleep.
Sylan uses Indomitable and saves with a 25. Gerk saves with a 23. Ord rolls a 17 and fails.
Ord uses Vigilant Rebuke once in reaction to the successful saves, dealing 14 damage. Eyes on the edge of the door pop.
Ord reaches into a gap between the eyes and starts to pass through. His mind is elsewhere, and that scene leaves the recorded channel.

notes: A wall of eyes occupies a door in front of the party and forces a Wisdom save on anyone standing adjacent to it.
The effect is a magical mental ability. It is not sleep and not charm.
Failing draws the victim in: Ord found a gap between the eyes and began to pass through.
Eyes on the very edge of the door popped when struck by Ord's Vigilant Rebuke.

Ord.existing: Dragonborn paladin and Gatekeeper of Feldspar.
notes: Confirmed in play as an Oath of the Watchers paladin. He previously had an Oath of Vengeance.
Failed the wall of eyes Wisdom save with a 17, including a +5 bonus.

Used Vigilant Rebuke once as a reaction to an ally's successful Wisdom save, dealing 14 damage and popping eyes on the edge of the door. The feature could not be used a second time because it costs a reaction.
Stepped into a gap between the eyes and began to pass through. His mind was elsewhere; the follow-up was taken off the recorded channel.
Stood adjacent to the wall of eyes, used Indomitable, and succeeded on the Wisdom save with a 25.
Watched Ord reach into the eyes and start to pass through.

Gerk.existing: Half-orc barbarian, Doorman, and keeper of the Midgard keystone.
notes: Stood adjacent to the wall of eyes and succeeded on the Wisdom save with a 23.
Watched Ord reach into the eyes and start to pass through.

Dana.existing: Half-elf cleric and Gatekeeper of Pitel.
notes: Moved as far from the wall of eyes as possible and was not among those forced to save.

Carlkin.existing: Turtle-like person previously believed to be back in Langdale.
notes: Is present at the wall of eyes and runs away. He is not among those forced to make the Wisdom save.

misTranscriptions.notes: Sylan says "I save Garpin" as the Wisdom saves begin. No matching name; may be a garbled "I saved" rather than a person.
DM denying that the wall of eyes is charm or sleep.
DM: "see if you can shist your way out of this" on the Wisdom save.
Gerk's 18 plus this bonus became 23 after the DM confirmed the bonus was 5.
Gerk asking for the size of the bonus; DM answers five.
Oath of the Watchers reaction Ord uses after a successful Wisdom save.
DM describing Vigilant Rebuke's damage dice before the roll of 9+5.
DM asking the damage type as the eyes pop. Earlier in the same ruling he called it mental damage.

newTerms.name: Wall of Eyes
notes: A door-filling mass of eyes with a magical mental effect. Adjacent creatures make a Wisdom save; failure draws the victim into a gap between the eyes. Eyes on the door's edge can be destroyed.

newTerms.name: Vigilant Rebuke
notes: Oath of the Watchers reaction. When a creature Ord can see succeeds on an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma save, he can deal damage back to the source. Used once here for 14 damage.
